title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
solution_code:
def solve(s):
    seen = set()
    left = 0
    max_len = 0
    for right, ch in enumerate(s):
        while ch in seen:
            seen.remove(s[left])
            left += 1
        seen.add(ch)
        max_len = max(max_len, right - left + 1)
    return max_len

title: Product of Array Except Self
solution_code:
def solve(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    res = [1] * n
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    postfix = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= postfix
        postfix *= nums[i]
    return res
explanation_correct_relevant: We compute prefix and suffix product sweeps in linear time without division.
explanation_correct_less_relevant: I pass through the list forward and then backward to gather context from both directions.
